title: By yard
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：by　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 by 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the nurse kept the thermometer ① by the end of the week at the cupboard, and everybody in the ward said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning: the thermometer had been left ② by the gate of the yard, and nobody had asked a single question. The nurse had come to the ward two nights earlier and spoke little of the ward he had left behind him.

The report for April 1973 puts it plainer. It was done ③ by hand, and the sufferer who kept the thermometer had taken it ④ by the old nurse twice before the winter came; nothing in the ward was ever done by hand in those days. The sufferer wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every night thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the thermometer at the far cupboard, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ by the rain and the wind, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ by the children; he was not a man who explained himself, and the ward had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1986 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the report. What the line asked for was that the thermometer be taken ⑦ by the light of one lamp, and that the names be written ⑧ by the hand of my mother. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried by the light of one lamp.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1989 she kept the thermometer ⑨ by the end of the week again when nobody else would, and ⑩ by the gate of the yard, she said in 1991, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the thermometer in the same cupboard for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the ward never forgot what had been done by the gate of the yard.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 被（表时间：by the end of the week）
B. prep. 被（表处所：by the gate of the yard）
C. prep. 靠（表方式／状态：by hand）
D. prep. 靠（引出施动者或相关的人：be taken by the old nurse）
E. prep. 被（表原因：by the rain and the wind）
F. prep. 靠（表对象／目的：by the children）
G. prep. 被（表工具／材料：by the light of one lamp）
H. prep. 靠（表载体／处所：written by the hand of my mother）

items.q: by the end of the week
by the gate of the yard
by the rain and the wind
by the light of one lamp
by the hand of my mother
by the end of the week again
by the gate of the yard, she said

answers.why: by 意为“被”，此处引出时间 the end of the week（周末之前），说明那件细细的体温计是在何时留下的。
by 意为“被”，此处引出处所 the gate of the yard（院门旁边），说明东西被放在何处。
by 意为“靠”，此处引出方式或状态 hand（手工），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
by 意为“靠”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 那位老护士：be taken by the old nurse。
by 意为“被”，此处引出原因 the rain and the wind（风雨），说明整件事由何而起。
by 意为“靠”，此处引出对象或目的 the children（孩子们）。
by 意为“被”，此处引出工具或材料 the light of one lamp（一盏灯的亮光）。
by 意为“靠”，此处引出载体 the hand of my mother（我母亲的手）：names written by the hand of my mother。
by 意为“被”，1989 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件细细的体温计，此处仍引出时间 the end of the week。
by 意为“被”，母亲 1991 年那句话引出的仍是那一处院门旁边。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1979 年周末之前前后，护士把那件细细的体温计留在了药柜。（by the end of the week）
那件细细的体温计被放在院门旁边，谁也没有过问。（by the gate of the yard）
整件事是手工做成的，护理记录上写得明白。（by hand）
入冬之前，那件细细的体温计已经由那位老护士服过两回。（be taken by the old nurse）
叔叔说，整件事是由风雨起的。（by the rain and the wind）
他说，家里从来没有人为孩子们做过这件事。（by the children）
answers: In 1979 the nurse kept the thermometer by the end of the week at the cupboard.
The thermometer had been left by the gate of the yard, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done by hand, or so the report says.
The thermometer had been taken by the old nurse twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun by the rain and the wind.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it by the children.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 by 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1979 the nurse kept the thermometer by the end of the week, and nobody forgot it.
The thermometer had been left by the gate of the yard for three nights.
The work was done by hand, as it always was in those days.
The thermometer had been taken by the old nurse twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the thermometer by the end of the week again when nobody else would.
The whole ward never forgot what had been done by the gate of the yard.
